name: 4-HO-MPT
summary: Psychedelic drug of the tryptamine class. Higher homologue of Psilocin, and is the 4-hydroxy analogue of N-Methyl-N-Propyltryptamine.
advisory: The drug does not appear to be active rectally.
doseBasis: NOTE: The drug does not appear to be active rectally.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a non-selective serotonin receptor agonist, including of the serotonin 5-HT2A receptor.
pharmacology.kind: Non-selective serotonin receptor agonist; Serotonin 5-HT2A receptor agonist; Serotonergic psychedelic; Hallucinogen

uses.text: The drug is taken orally. It was encountered as a novel designer drug by 2021.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the psilocin-like tryptamines, can cause nausea, yawning, dilated pupils, muscle tension, a faster heartbeat, anxiety, confusion and frightening experiences. In people at risk, they can trigger lasting mental health problems such as psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。與它同類、類似脫磷酸裸蓋菇素（psilocin）的色胺類藥物，可能引起噁心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉緊繃、心跳加快、焦慮、意識混亂與驚恐的經驗。對本身有風險的人，可能誘發精神病等持久的心理健康問題。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。与它同类、类似脱磷酸裸盖菇素（psilocin）的色胺类药物，可能引起恶心、打哈欠、瞳孔放大、肌肉紧绷、心跳加快、焦虑、意识混乱与惊恐的经验。对本身有风险的人，可能诱发精神病等持久的心理健康问题。

fact.en: Its nitrogen carries one methyl group and one three-carbon propyl group, making it one carbon chain longer on one side than psilocin.
fact.zh: 它的氮原子上接著一個甲基與一個三碳的丙基，因此在一側比脫磷酸裸蓋菇素多出一段碳鏈。
fact.zhHans: 它的氮原子上接着一个甲基与一个三碳的丙基，因此在一侧比脱磷酸裸盖菇素多出一段碳链。
